qualificationScope: Supported selection/terrain API parity; shipped exposure and hidden-score impact unknown.
hypothesis: Off-map wildcard footprint is rejected by JS although C treats outside cells as STONE.
contractRationale: Pattern [.w.] has odd dimensions 5x1 and valid MATCH_WALL center; it is also an existing shipped literal. l_selection_match tests every map center, including x=78. All three authored cells x=77,78,79 are valid. Only the pattern footprint extends to x=80; C explicitly supplies STONE for that position, so the query is supported rather than an invalid coordinate write.
supportedSetup: Exported production selection API consumed by production lspo_terrain; default whole-level frame xstart=1, initialized GameMap, no injected loader or invalid terrain writes.
expectedCAndObservedJS: C selects and paints absolute (78,10); JS selects no cell. Interior (40,10) matches.
control: Interior center (40,10) selects and paints identically. Earlier 20-template/2200-point controls remain historical finite evidence, not universal equivalence.
oracleProvenance: Bundled exact upstream C algorithm bodies with minimal selection/map storage. Literal coordinate translation and fixed-pattern construction follow the public Lua wrapper contract. Full Lua parser and recorder are not executed. Painted C coordinates are the selected coordinates: writing HWALL at these valid, non-stair cells cannot be rejected.
scope: Finite supported-API candidate. Older unresolved disposition required shipped exposure; current qualification separates API validity from exposure. No global equivalence or hidden-score claim.
